description: Deterministic release-gate contract for the PetTripFinder San Antonio / Greater San Antonio market through PTF-SAN-ANTONIO-TX-REGISTRATION-AND-STAGING-003. Every number is derived from THIS market's committed authority by release_contracts.derive_authority; none is typed and none is inherited from or comparable to another market's contract.

deployment_authorization.means: A passing contract means this market's assembled package is STRUCTURALLY deployable: its authority files agree, its routes match its reviewed inventory, no held identity leaks, and every publish gate holds. It is not a deployment authorization and asserts nothing about the market being complete -- 172 of this market's 414 registered identities are still unresolved, and no founder deployment decision exists for San Antonio at 144 published profiles.

identity_census.note: 414 registered identities, built from zero by PTF-SAN-ANTONIO-TX-HARDENED-SOURCE-READY-001 on the Austin-live hardened lineage, retried for Hilton by PTF-SAN-ANTONIO-TX-HILTON-PACED-RETRY-002 (no row changed), and registered by PTF-SAN-ANTONIO-TX-REGISTRATION-AND-STAGING-003. Membership is this market's own corridor postal partition (census_membership_basis CORRIDOR_REGISTRY): 19 corridors over the admitted Greater San Antonio postal codes -- Downtown / River Walk, Pearl / Broadway, Southtown, the SAT airport, the Medical Center, North Central, Stone Oak, Northwest / La Cantera, Six Flags / Rim, SeaWorld / Westover Hills, Lackland / West, the East Side, the South Side and the Northeast at CORE; Live Oak / Universal City, Selma / Schertz and Leon Valley / Helotes as CORRIDOR; Converse and Bulverde as FRINGE. Austin (live), New Braunfels, Seguin, San Marcos, the destination Hill Country (Boerne, Comfort, Kerrville, Bandera, Fredericksburg), Castroville / Hondo, the rural outer ring and Corpus Christi are named, refused and preserved: 0 rows are admitted from a refused postal code. On-base military lodging at the JBSA installations is MILITARY_RESTRICTED and never admitted. A name decides nothing: a code binds only under its own brand, and two brand codes at one address are two buildings (4 such buildings are held). Timeshare and vacation ownership (Hilton Vacation Club Eilan, Hyatt Vacation Club Wild Oak Ranch, Shell Vacations Club), apartments, RV parks and short-term rentals are never admitted, and a hotel whose own page or brand card says it has not opened never publishes. Rows the identity graph did not admit are recorded, not dropped: 148 IDENTITY_REVIEW_REQUIRED; 230 NAME_ONLY_UNRESOLVED; 101 NON_LODGING; 540 OUTSIDE_MARKET; 7 SAME_CAMPUS_DISTINCT_ENTITY.

reconciliation.note: 144 clean pet-friendly and 98 clean verified-no-pets over a 414-identity census. A row publishes only on an OPERATIVE first-party quote from the property's own page, read by the repaired shared reader (an FAQ question is never an acceptance, and an explicit refusal always wins), bound to its census identity by the property code or the full street identity that page states: a fee, a weight, a count, an amenity chip or a service-animal sentence alone publishes nothing, one page that binds two census rows publishes for neither, and an identity the census cannot address never publishes. 172 identities did not publish (28 ACCESS_BLOCKED; 17 EVIDENCE_HOLD; 16 IDENTITY_MISMATCH_HOLD; 81 ROUTING_HOLD; 30 SOURCE_SILENT); every one is named in san_antonio_tx_clean_authority_001.json with its class. No gate was lowered to preserve a count.

policy_package.note: The verified hotel identities are DERIVED from this package at assembly time via site_data.verified_public_hotels(); they are not restated here. Every record carries the exact operator quote for each published fact, the capture lane, and the sha256 of the document it was read from.

final_partition.note: The partition of record for this market, referenced by path and content digest so the whole-site assembler resolves it from THIS contract rather than from a table in its own source. Written from the committed file by release_contracts.final_partition_block; verified by market_partition_resolution: the file must exist, declare this market_id, hash to expected_sha256 and carry expected_count identities. Regenerating the partition means reissuing this block.

public_surface.held_hotel_exclusion: Every seed hotel this market owns that is absent from the committed package (not-published seed hotels: held/manual-review plus rows still pending evidence) must have NO public route and NO reference on any surface: hotel profiles, the hotels listing/category page, nearby-lodging cards on any page, the policy-comparison table, the sitemap, canonicals, internal links, and /go/ interstitials. This market currently holds none -- every seed row it owns is published -- and the gate is derived, so it starts enforcing the moment that changes.

routes.note: route_mode market_prefixed: this market's hub, corridor and policy-comparison pages live under /pet-friendly-hotels/san-antonio-tx/. 12 of 19 corridors reach their own publication minimum; the rest are suppressed, which is a threshold and not a gap. The market and its corridors are hidden from navigation and the sitemap (show_in_navigation=false, show_in_sitemap=false) until a launch order says otherwise.

publish.note: The publish root must contain ONLY the static website plus the two Netlify control files. Build-internal reports the generator emits (_build_report.json, _broken_link_report.json, _quality_report.json, bundle_manifest.json) are read for gating but are excluded from site/ and must never ship.
